notes:
DntSpace v0.4.11

### Added
- Multi-agent: child completion results injected live into the root turn ([child-result] notices), mid-flight child follow-ups, per-subagent follow-up/close actions in the Environment panel
- Loop context modes: fresh context per run or dedicated runner sub-chat; full mode auto-compacts before dispatch when context is nearly full
- Plugins: content plugins installable from a GitHub repo archive; service plugins resolve plugin.json from the upstream repo
- Workbench: git stage/unstage/discard/commit actions
- Background process agent tools (chat-only, never in workflows)

### Fixed
- Gemini API key moved from URL query to x-goog-api-key header (no key leaks in provider errors); license_* settings blocked over generic IPC
- read_file handles byte caps that split UTF-8 characters; glob terminates on symlink/junction cycles
- Catalog plugin installs fetch the GitHub repo/release on the target machine
